verses.english: This was said by the Buddha, the Perfected One: that is what I heard.

verses.pali: “Mānaṁ, bhikkhave, anabhijānaṁ aparijānaṁ tattha cittaṁ avirājayaṁ appajahaṁ abhabbo dukkhakkhayāya.
verses.english: “Mendicants, without directly knowing and completely understanding conceit, without dispassion for it and giving it up, you can’t end suffering.

verses.pali: Mānañca kho, bhikkhave, abhijānaṁ parijānaṁ tattha cittaṁ virājayaṁ pajahaṁ bhabbo dukkhakkhayāyā”ti.
verses.english: By directly knowing and completely understanding conceit, having dispassion for it and giving it up, you can end suffering.”
“These folk are caught up in conceit,
tied by conceit, delighting in existence.
Those who have given up conceit,
freed with the ending of conceit,
vanquishers of the tie of conceit,

verses.pali: Ayampi attho vutto bhagavatā, iti me sutanti.
verses.english: This too is a matter that was spoken by the Blessed One: that is what I heard.
